title: Co-encapsulation of vitamin D3 and curcumin in plant protein-based nanoemulsions: formulation optimization, characterization, and in vitro digestion
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, 3,2204-2214

This study aimed to develop plant-based nanoemulsions (NE) for co-encapsulation of vitamin D3 and curcumin, comparing the emulsifying properties of pea and potato proteins.
